title: 上海交大教授：信贷放缓，增长靠创新？
speaker: Yvonne

segments.en: So if we do see the structural downshift in the credit impulse, where is the growth going to come from?
segments.zh: 如果信贷脉冲出现结构性下降，增长将从何而来？

segments.en: Well, I think China is trying to engineer its growth from the more debt-driven or credit-driven to the more technology or innovation-driven model.
segments.zh: 我认为中国正试图将增长模式从债务驱动转向技术或创新驱动。

segments.en: So I think it is going towards that direction. And somehow by design, I think this will require less credit and less lending from the financial institutions.
segments.zh: 我认为正朝着这个方向前进。某种程度上，这需要更少的信贷和金融机构贷款。

segments.en: So this is not necessarily a bad thing as Governor Pan pointed out. So I think we are counting more on innovation such as new energy vehicles, photovoltaics and AI.
segments.zh: 正如潘行长所说，这未必是坏事。我们更依赖创新，比如新能源汽车、光伏和人工智能。

segments.en: And high-end semiconductor innovation and I think more and more of the growth. Hopefully, we'll be coming from those areas rather than the traditional lending-intensive housing sectors.
segments.zh: 还有高端半导体创新，希望增长越来越多来自这些领域，而非传统的贷款密集型房地产行业。
